description: Renovate enables GitHub's native auto-merge, so a pull request merges once the required checks pass rather than only during a Renovate run. A workflow cannot do this: it would authenticate with GITHUB_TOKEN, which has no `workflows` permission, and nearly every update here touches .github/workflows, so GitHub would disable auto-merge again with 'Tried to create or update workflow without workflows permission'. The Renovate app does hold that permission.

packageRules.description: actions/github-script is only used by the cleanup and verify workflows, which are scheduled and therefore never run on a pull request. An update to it cannot be validated before merging, and the cleanup deletes package versions, so it stays manual.

The dockerfile manager extracts the apt pins but cannot infer a registry from the base image, so point deb lookups at the suite and components that the Dockerfile actually configures. binaryArch is amd64 because multiple registryUrls would be merged as a union rather than an intersection, which would weaken the check; the multi-arch build is what guards against an arch-specific binNMU.

customManagers.description: npm install -g is not covered by a built-in manager.
